music.name: R&B & Golf
music.address: Diablo Creek Golf Course, Concord, CA
music.why: A three-hour golf-and-R&B mixer with instruction and clubs provided, not just another club night — beginners and regulars both welcome.
music.summary: DJ Heartbreak's R&B & Golf returns to Diablo Creek Golf Course in Concord on Saturday, August 22, with three hours of golf, R&B music, professional instruction, giveaways, and a closing mixer.

music.name: West Coast Jungle Showcase
music.why: An all-California jungle/DNB lineup at a warehouse-style spot whose address only drops the day of the show — presale-only entry.
music.summary: Rhythmic Remedies' West Coast Jungle Showcase hits a secret Oakland location on Saturday, August 22, with a heavy-hitting lineup of West Coast jungle and DNB DJs/producers, 9pm to late.

music.name: AnjunaFamily SF Community Gathering
music.why: Openers are chosen by community vote from a mix-submission pool rather than booked outright, so the lineup is crowd-picked local talent.
music.summary: AnjunaFamily SF returns to Bella SF on Saturday, August 22 from 7pm to close for a community gathering with local-talent openers chosen by public vote.

music.name: SO HOUSE... YOUR EVENING SO FAR?
music.why: A Monday-night house residency in the Mission that turns the start of the week into a dance floor, not a weekend-only booking.
music.summary: Blends & Trends' SO HOUSE... YOUR EVENING SO FAR? returns to The Valencia Room on Monday, August 17, with Okoyemusic, Modeleeloo, and Yango.dj on the decks from 9pm late.

music.name: Mirage
music.address: Mersea Restaurant Bar & Venue, Treasure Island, San Francisco, CA
music.why: A sunset party on Treasure Island's waterfront deck, trading a warehouse for open bay views at golden hour.
music.summary: Mirage returns to Treasure Island on Sunday, August 23, at Mersea Restaurant Bar & Venue for a sunset party overlooking the bay.

music.name: Rival Consoles Live A/V Tour
music.why: A full audio-visual narrative set from an electronic composer, not a DJ set - deep listening over a dance-floor filler night
music.summary: Rival Consoles (Ryan Lee West) brings his Landscape from Memory A/V Tour to 1015 Folsom on Thursday August 20, an immersive live audio-visual performance co-created with visual artist David Sydiongco spanning ambient to techno, with support from Khotin and MOSTASH.

music.name: Wobbleland 2026
music.address: 150 W San Carlos St, San Jose, CA 95113
music.why: Excision-headlined 2-day bass festival with a stacked dubstep/hardstyle lineup - the biggest single production in the Bay Area this week
music.summary: Wobbleland 2026, presented by Bassrush, is a two-day bass music festival at the San Jose Convention Center Friday-Saturday August 21-22, headlined by Excision, Alison Wonderland and NGHTMRE across dubstep, hardstyle, drum & bass and trap.

music.name: LEVI at The Midway
music.address: The Midway SF, San Francisco, CA
music.why: Promoter is running a guest-list giveaway ahead of the date, a sign of active ticket-push for this club night.
music.summary: LEVI plays The Midway SF on Saturday, August 22, with the venue running a pre-show guest-list giveaway.

music.why: A stacked house day-party bill headlined by a global house name, open-air and 18+, the biggest single club night in the Bay this week outside Wobbleland.

Broken Promises: R&B Night
music.why: Kicks off a two-city R&B weekend the night before its Concord sister date, mixing R&B staples with hip-hop classics.
music.summary: DJ Heartbreak's Broken Promises R&B party hits Dragon Gate in Oakland on Friday, August 21, the first night of a two-city Bay Area weekend.

music.name: Broken Promises: R&B Night
music.why: A rare Saturday-night edition of the Bay's biggest R&B party, with DJ Elijah Jaron joining Heartbreak on the decks.
music.summary: Broken Promises, the Bay Area's biggest R&B party, returns to Vinnie's Bar & Grill in Concord for a rare Saturday-night edition on August 22, with DJ Heartbreak and guest DJ Elijah Jaron.

music.name: Pink Stiletto — Hot Goth GF Radio Special
music.address: Thee Stork Club, 2330 Telegraph Ave, Oakland, CA 94612
music.why: SF synthpop artist Pink Stiletto's Bay Area homecoming show, fresh off a full European tour.
music.summary: Hot Goth GF Radio hosts a dark synthpop and dreamy electronics night at Thee Stork Club in Oakland on Wednesday, August 19, headlined by San Francisco's Pink Stiletto with NYC's Observation Room (on tour) and local act Spectre Oakland.

sports.name: Taco Tuesday Moto Ride
sports.why: A biker-community taco night open to all motorcycles and riders, co-hosted by four Bay Area MC clubs for dinner and conversation.
sports.summary: Underdogs Too hosts a Taco Tuesday for the biker community on August 18, co-hosted by Delinquents Motorcycle Club, Delinquents MC San Jose, Family & Motorcycles, and Throttle Island T.I. — all motorcycles and riders welcome.

sports.name: Santa Rosa Marathon Weekend
sports.why: A two-day race weekend with distances for every level, 5K/10K Saturday and half/full marathon Sunday, in a city Vasilii is willing to travel to.
sports.summary: The Santa Rosa Marathon Weekend runs 5K and 10K races Saturday, August 22, with the half and full marathon Sunday, August 23, through downtown Santa Rosa.
